messages:
Nora: Pushed a small docs PR that adds a compact quickstart for Optimize focusing on short-context apps + a brief Ruby snippet and a curl example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4932
Jai: nice. Can we keep the quickstart to one screen so new users can copy-paste?
Nora: yes 5 I made a single callout card with a 4-line TL;DR and then the expansions below.
Marco: please include the recommended hosted-safe defaults: batch_size <= 8, kv_prefetch=true for shortseq, quant_profile=qprofile-compact.
Nora: added that in the top callout. Also added a tiny rollback note: pin quant_profile to "legacy-v0.9" if you observe regressions.
Tess: can we have a Ruby snippet? ops teams sometimes run quick sanity checks with Ruby scripts.
Nora: added a short Ruby example and a minimal curl form. Ruby snippet:
```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: 'redwood/opt-mini-1.0', inputs: ['Who won the world cup in 2018?'], max_tokens: 32, batch_size: 4, kv_prefetch: true, quant_profile: 'qprofile-compact')
puts resp[0].text
```
Jai: looks good. Can you also include the exact eval command so QE can reproduce perf numbers?
Nora: added `./tools/eval_shortseq.sh --model redwood/opt-mini-1.0 --quant qprofile-compact --corpus docs/examples/optimize/shortseq-lite.json` in the migration checklist.
Marco: tiny suggestion: in the quick-reco box change wording to "Short (Q/A <64 tokens)" so it's explicit.
Nora: updated wording. Also added a 1-line tokenization example to explain drift: "token ids: ['What',' is',' the',' capital'] -> [101, 5, 9, 402] -> different split can flip a short answer"
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded 5 https://redwood-docs-pr-preview.netlify.app/pr/4932 5 3 files changed.
Tess: LGTM from me for examples and wording.
Jai: LGTM for eval bits. Marco: LGTM for perf recommendations.
Nora: merging after CI green. I'll open a follow-up issue to track shortseq telemetry in infra. Thanks all :rocket:
